title: Elden Ring for PS5 drops to its lowest price of the season
summary: One of the best action RPGs of the decade, now at a Black Friday price on Amazon.
why: Elden Ring launched at $59.99 and has rarely gone deep on discount for the physical PS5 disc. This Black Friday markdown is one of the biggest cuts we have seen, and it is sold and shipped by Amazon, so you are not dealing with a third-party seller.
who: Anyone who skipped Elden Ring at launch
PS5 owners building a holiday backlog
Gift buyers: the disc version wraps nicely and has resale value later
watch: This is the base game. The Shadow of the Erdtree expansion is sold separately. Make sure the listing says PlayStation 5, not PS4.
verdict: Easy buy if it's been on your list. At this price it is hard to beat the hours-per-dollar.

title: LEGO Star Wars TIE Fighter with Imperial Hangar Rack (40771) — Prime member deal
summary: A hard-to-find set that originally came as a gift-with-purchase, now available on its own with a Prime-member discount.
why: Set 40771 was first released as a promotional gift-with-purchase, which is why it is tough to find in stores. Collectors chase it because it docks to the 75419 Death Star set. Amazon is running a Prime-exclusive price below its regular listing tonight.
who: Star Wars LEGO collectors
Anyone who owns or plans to buy the 75419 Death Star
Gift shoppers looking for something less common
watch: The lower price is for Prime members only, and the listing is sold by a third-party store (shipped by Amazon). Check the seller name at checkout.
verdict: Worth grabbing if you collect Star Wars LEGO. Promo sets like this usually get harder to find, not easier.

title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance Deluxe Edition (Switch 2) gets a big Black Friday cut
summary: SEGA's well-reviewed Shinobi revival, Deluxe Edition, at a deep Black Friday discount.
why: Deluxe Edition includes the game plus extra character costumes, an art book and the soundtrack. It's one of the better side-scrolling action games of the past year, and this is the lowest we have seen the Deluxe version.
who: Switch 2 owners who like fast 2D action games
Fans of the original Shinobi and Streets of Rage
Anyone wanting a shorter game to finish over the holidays
watch: This is a Game-Key Card. The box contains a key that downloads the full game, so you need an internet connection and storage space.
verdict: Great value for action fans. Skip it if you only want full physical cartridges.

title: EA Sports College Football 27 (PS5) is under $30 for Black Friday
summary: This year's College Football game is less than half price on the PS5 disc.
why: It's still this season's game, so rosters and Dynasty mode are current. The deep cut is happening because Black Friday sports-game pricing starts early. Best Buy is matching it on other EA titles this week.
who: College football fans who held off at full price
Dynasty mode players
Gift buyers: sports games are some of the most-returned gifts, but this one rarely is
watch: Make sure you pick 'PlayStation 5 - Disc'. The listing also has digital and Xbox versions at different prices.
verdict: If you play it every year, this is the time to buy.

title: Best Buy Doorbuster: FC 27, Madden 27 and NHL 27 for PS5 are $29.99
summary: Three of this year's EA Sports games are $40 off as Best Buy Doorbusters.
why: Best Buy cut FC 27, Madden NFL 27 and NHL 27 on PS5 to $29.99 each. That's about 57% off, the lowest price any of them has hit since launch. Free store pickup was available as soon as tomorrow when we checked.
who: Sports gamers who want this year's rosters
Families buying a game for each kid
Anyone switching from last year's edition
watch: Doorbusters can sell out or end before Black Friday week is over. These are the PS5 disc versions.
verdict: The best price on these three games this year. Pick the sport you'll actually play.

title: Kasa KP200 in-wall smart outlet: an easy smart-home upgrade for less
summary: A smart outlet that replaces a regular wall outlet, no hub needed. It's on a Black Friday deal.
why: Plug-in smart plugs stick out and block the second outlet. The KP200 replaces the outlet itself, so both sockets are independently controllable through Alexa, Google Home or the Kasa app, with nothing hanging off the wall.
who: Renters with landlord permission or homeowners comfortable with basic wiring
Anyone automating lamps or holiday lights
People who already use Kasa/TP-Link plugs
watch: This one needs installation in a wall box and a neutral wire. If you aren't comfortable with wiring, hire an electrician or get a plug-in smart plug instead.
verdict: A clean, lasting upgrade over plug-in smart plugs at a good price.

title: UGREEN Uno Qi2 2-in-1 charging stand is 45% off
summary: A Qi2-certified 15W stand for iPhone plus AirPods, with a little robot face, at a big discount.
why: Qi2 certification means it charges at the full 15W on magnetic phones instead of slower off-brand speeds. It folds flat for travel and charges your earbuds on the base at the same time.
who: iPhone 12 and newer owners
Anyone who wants a nightstand charger that also handles AirPods
Stocking-stuffer shoppers on a tech budget
watch: The power adapter isn't included. You need a USB-C wall charger of 30W or more to get full speed.
verdict: A solid Qi2 stand for less than most uncertified ones.

title: Anker Nano 10-in-1 desk clamp power strip: desk clean-up on sale
summary: Clamps to the edge of your desk with 6 AC outlets and 4 USB ports, including 70W USB-C. Discounted for Black Friday.
why: Most power strips live on the floor, so cables end up stretching everywhere. This one clamps to the front or side of the desk, so chargers and lamps plug in at hand height. The 70W USB-C port can charge a laptop.
who: Home-office and gaming desk setups
Students in dorms
Anyone tired of crawling under the desk to plug things in
watch: Check that your desk edge is 0.6–1.8 inches thick so the clamp fits.
verdict: One of the most useful desk upgrades you can get for the money.

title: Xbox Wireless Controller + USB-C cable bundle is 34% off
summary: The standard Xbox controller in Carbon Black with a 9-foot USB-C cable, on sale.
why: It works with Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows PCs and phones, so it's the easiest second controller to buy. The included cable means you can play wired without buying anything else.
who: Xbox owners who need a second controller
PC gamers who want a reliable gamepad
Families adding a player for the holidays
watch: Runs on AA batteries by default. Rechargeable batteries are sold separately.
verdict: A dependable controller at a price that doesn't come around often.

title: Stanley Quencher H2.0 14 oz is half off in several colors
summary: The smaller, cup-holder-friendly Stanley Quencher at a Black Friday price.
why: The 14 oz size is popular for kids, coffee and cup holders that the 40 oz won't fit. Several colors were half off on Amazon tonight, which makes it an easy stocking stuffer.
who: Kids and teens
Coffee drinkers who want something smaller than 40 oz
Gift exchanges with a price cap
watch: Deal prices vary by color. Check the color you pick before you add it to your cart.
verdict: A crowd-pleasing small gift at a good price.

title: LEGO City Pizza Delivery Experience (60496) is 20% off
summary: A new 494-piece LEGO City set with a restaurant, three vehicles and five minifigures, on sale.
why: This is a 2026 set, so discounts have been rare. It has a lot of play value for the piece count: a restaurant with an oven function, a pizza delivery scooter, a sports car and a drone.
who: Kids ages 6 and up
LEGO City fans
Parents shopping for a mid-price main gift
watch: Sold and shipped by Amazon. Holiday delivery dates are getting longer, so check the delivery estimate.
verdict: A solid kids' gift with lots of play for the price.

title: HP OmniBook 5 14" OLED laptop is $449.99 at Best Buy
summary: A 2026 laptop with a 2K OLED touchscreen for under $450. That's $350 off.
why: OLED screens used to be limited to $1,000+ laptops. This OmniBook 5 has a 14-inch 2K OLED touch display, an Intel Core 5 Series 3 chip and Copilot+ AI features, and it's sold by Best Buy with free pickup.
who: Students and everyday users
Anyone who watches a lot of video on their laptop
First-laptop buyers who want a great screen
watch: 8GB of memory and 256GB of storage are on the light side for heavy multitasking or big photo libraries. Check the 512GB version if you store a lot.
verdict: The best screen you'll find at this price. A strong pick for school and streaming.

title: Hisense 75" M7 MiniLED TV is $499.99 — $400 off
summary: A 75-inch MiniLED TV with Roku built in, for $499.99.
why: MiniLED backlighting gives much better brightness and contrast than basic LED TVs at this size. Getting a 2026 MiniLED model at 75 inches for under $500 is one of the standout TV deals this Black Friday.
who: Living rooms upgrading from a 55–65 inch TV
Sports watchers who want a bright screen
Roku users who want a familiar interface
watch: At 75 inches, check your wall or stand space and whether the TV fits in your car for pickup. Best Buy also offers free delivery.
verdict: Excellent picture for the price at this size.

title: KitchenAid 4.5-Qt Tilt-Head Stand Mixer is $279 at Walmart
summary: The classic KitchenAid tilt-head mixer is $171 off at Walmart in several colors.
why: The 4.5-quart KSM97 is the go-to size for most home bakers and handles cookies, bread dough and frosting easily. This is one of the lowest prices of the year, and several colors are on sale.
who: New bakers and newlyweds
Holiday cookie season
Anyone replacing an old hand mixer
watch: If you bake big batches of bread, the 5-quart models give more room. Price can vary by color.
verdict: A buy-it-once kitchen tool at a great price.

title: Cuisinart Cook Central 3-in-1 multicooker is $80 off
summary: A 6-quart slow cooker that can also brown and steam, so you use one pot instead of three.
why: You can sear meat right in the pot before slow cooking, which means fewer dishes and better flavor. The programmable timer switches to keep-warm on its own.
who: Busy families who slow-cook
Small kitchens short on counter space
Holiday hosts
watch: This is a slow cooker, not a pressure cooker. If you want fast cooking, look at an Instant Pot instead.
verdict: A great one-pot upgrade from a basic slow cooker.

title: LEGO Editions FIFA World Cup Official Trophy (43020) is $80 off at Target
summary: The big golden World Cup trophy display set at its best price so far.
why: This 2,800+ piece adult display set is one of LEGO's showpiece sets for 2026, a World Cup year. $80 off is the biggest discount we've seen on it.
who: Soccer fans
Adult LEGO builders who like display pieces
A big-ticket gift for someone who has everything
watch: Only 4 were left at the store we checked. Shipping may be the safer bet.
verdict: A great gift for soccer fans at a price that won't last long.

title: Husqvarna 150BT gas backpack leaf blower is $100 off at Lowe's
summary: A homeowner-favorite backpack blower is discounted through December 2.
why: The 150BT moves serious air (765 CFM) for its price class and is far less tiring than a handheld blower on big yards. Lowe's has it $100 off with free pickup.
who: Homeowners with half an acre or more
Anyone with lots of trees
People upgrading from a cordless handheld
watch: It's a 2-cycle gas engine, so you'll need to mix fuel and oil. It's also loud, so check your town's noise rules.
verdict: A strong value if you have a big yard to clear.

title: How BoominDeals picks deals (and what we skip)
summary: Our checklist for every deal we post, so you know a deal here has actually been checked.
body: Every deal on BoominDeals is checked by hand on the store's own product page before we post it. We note the price, the 'was' or list price the store shows, who sells and ships it, and any catch, like Prime-only pricing, a third-party seller or a game-key card instead of a full cartridge.

We skip a lot. Fake 'was' prices, deals that are cheaper elsewhere, products with weak reviews, and listings sold by unknown marketplace sellers usually don't make the cut. On a typical night we look at 50–100 deals to post 15–30.
Every post includes who the product is actually for and what to watch out for, because the cheapest option isn't always the best one for you.
Prices change fast, especially during Black Friday. Each post shows the date and time we checked it. Always confirm the final price at checkout.

title: Black Friday 2026 video game deals: which ones are actually worth it
summary: We checked dozens of game deals tonight. Here's what's a real discount and what's just normal pricing in a Black Friday banner.
body: The standout this week is this year's sports games. FC 27, Madden 27 and NHL 27 are $29.99 on PS5 at Best Buy, and College Football 27 is under $30 on Amazon. That's more than half off games that came out a few months ago.
Older hits are also cheap. Elden Ring for PS5 is at one of its lowest prices ever. Remember it doesn't include the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.

Not every 'deal' is a deal. Several newer games were only a few dollars below their usual sale price, and some 'Deluxe' editions are just a download code in a box. Read the platform and edition line before you buy.

Switch 2 owners: many third-party Switch 2 games ship as Game-Key Cards, meaning the cartridge downloads the game. That's fine if you have storage and internet, but it matters if you like to lend or trade games.
Our rule of thumb: if a game was on your list anyway and it's 50% off or more, buy it now. If it's 20–30% off, it will probably be that price again by January.
